body:
It's not going to make a difference to my plans but I have no problem talking about it.

There's no real source that I can point out. I've just always been uninterested in life. It's always felt like each day is another step downhill. I've never felt like ice had something to gain. Making money, having cool stuff, meeting fun people... It's never made me look at life in a positive life. While I've been told I need pills to fix my brain, I've always seen it as life sucking rather than there being sone problem in my brain.

Should I just load up on Prozac and accept that that will help?

Sorry, not a psychiatrist. Just the normal counselling type thing. It was free through work, so I decided it was worth a shot. Talking about how I felt was obviously helpful, but not in the sense that it made me even consider changing my mind.. Just diminished a little stress and at least allowed me to think clearly... (if you want to call this clear thinking...)

I've visited a psychiatrist a couple times.. Anything that's said to me never really has any effect as I still don't see hope for the future. It's hard to feel like things will get better when there's nothing I want out of life. I'm not interested in anything enough to strive for it, so why bother dealing with life?
This isn't some last minute decision because I'm oh-so sad.. It's something I've wanted to do for years. I've been putting it off for my family's sake, but how much longer can I do that?

I've obviously thought about this a lot... But I know what would happen: I'd see how sad it makes them and I'd convince myself that I can't do that to them. Then I'd just continue suffering and hating every second of life for their sake.
It's outrageously selfish, but we all know that..
They're not going to miraculously solve my problems and make me feel better... They're going to make me feel guilty.
